content.short: Nexabit is an AI-driven data infrastructure on TON providing institutional-grade market intelligence.
content.description: Nexabit AI is a cutting-edge data infrastructure project designed to provide TON users with sophisticated market intelligence powered by advanced AI and institutional data sources. It aggregates trading patterns from 'whales' and major financial players to identify emerging trends and optimal entry points in the crypto markets. Nexabit provides users with a comprehensive mini-app where they can access real-time analytics and participate in community-led data farming. By democratizing access to professional-grade market insights, Nexabit empowers the TON community to trade with greater confidence and accuracy.
content.meta: Access high-level TON market intelligence with Nexabit AI. Data-driven trading tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
